So, what are your plans for next year, Tom?
B
Well, I'm thinking of taking a gap year before college.
A
Wow, really? What would you do all year?
B
I'm going to work part-time and save up for a trip to Japan.
A
That sounds amazing. Will you go alone?
B
Probably. My cousin might come along if she gets time off.
A
Nice. My parents want me to start university right away, though.
B
Have you told them what you really want?
A
Not yet. I'll bring it up this weekend, I promise.
B
Good luck! Keep me posted, okay?

exq.q: What is Tom thinking of doing next year?
exq.a: Taking a gap year before college
exq.why: “I'm thinking of taking a gap year before college.” = nghỉ một năm trước đại học.

exq.q: How will Tom pay for his trip?
exq.a: By working part-time and saving up
exq.why: “work part-time and save up for a trip” = làm thêm và để dành tiền.

exq.q: What do Hana's parents want her to do?
exq.why: “My parents want me to start university right away.”

exq.q: What will Hana do this weekend?
exq.a: Talk to her parents about what she wants
exq.why: “I'll bring it up this weekend” = cuối tuần sẽ nói chuyện với bố mẹ.
